description: Every Mainer should be able to get the health care and support they need without traveling hours, waiting months for an appointment, or worrying that getting care will put them in financial hardship. My goal is simple: health care and social services should be accessible, efficient, and affordable for Mainers at every stage of life.My Plan to Deliver Better Healthcare Closer to Home • Bring more health care professionals to rural Maine.
